mechanism: Quetiapine may increase risk of electrolyte disturbances (hyponatremia, hypocalcemia) and both drugs can cause CNS effects and renal impairment; zoledronic acid-induced hypocalcemia may potentiate quetiapine's effects on cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (especially calcium and sodium), renal function, and cardiac conduction; ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion and assess for additive CNS depression.
